issues.issue: This is an irrigation district, not a public power district or utility.
The rules list water and drainage districts under natural resources/conservation. An irrigation district's operating expenses arguably fit there better than 'utilities'.

The whole entity is treated as business-type, but its only own-source revenue is printed as property taxes. Western_NE_Joint_Water_Board_FY2025, a comparable waiver form, was treated as governmental. The fund-type treatment is a judgment call and isn't consistent across similar entities.

issues.on_page: compilation letter: 'as of January 31, 2025', dated February 10, 2025; form '2025 Audit Waiver Request', no period printed
issues.issue: No period is printed on the form. The notes say 'check the period', but there is no decision_needed entry. Whether the year ends 1/31/2025 (or 12/31/2024) and belongs to FY2025 is a question for a person.
